solutions.check: grid rebuilt from the blog's light list (unique after crossings); every answer written into it with each crossing agreeing

clue.text: Mock? In a second almost comes to like Greek drama

indicators.note: the word for mock is placed in the shortened word for a second
almost means the last letter is dropped

parts.note: a tick is a moment, a second
to rag is to tease or mock

explanation.surface: Someone sneers that a play nearly turns into Greek tragedy in an instant.
explanation.walkthrough: 'almost' cuts the last letter from the word for a second, and 'In' places the word for mock inside what remains.
explanation.definitionFit: Greek drama is famed for its tragedies, so tragic describes something resembling it.

clue.text: Deliver on location, as told

indicators.note: as told signals that the word is spoken, so it is entered by its sound

explanation.surface: Instructions to give a speech on site, as one was instructed.
explanation.walkthrough: 'as told' marks SITE as heard, written CITE.
explanation.definitionFit: To deliver a speech or poem is to recite it, saying it out to an audience.

clue.text: Buy good new clothes reduced in response to explosion

indicators.note: clothes means the rearranged letters wrap around the other word
new signals the letters are made into a fresh arrangement

explanation.surface: Shopping advice: purchase good new clothes at reduced prices.
explanation.walkthrough: 'clothes' is a verb, not the purchase: 'new' rearranges the first two words, which wrap round the word for reduced. The explosion is a sneeze.
explanation.definitionFit: The customary words said after someone sneezes, the explosion in question.

clue.text: Man arrives at a lake in dense thickets

parts.note: arr. is the timetable abbreviation for arrives
L is the map abbreviation for lake

explanation.surface: A man reaches a lake through thick undergrowth.
explanation.definitionFit: Chaparral is the dense scrubby brushwood of California and Mexico, a mass of thickets.

clue.text: In unstable state, I must avoid responsibility

indicators.note: must avoid means the letter is kept out of the longer word

explanation.surface: A person in a shaky condition insists they must dodge any responsibility.
explanation.definitionFit: Lability is a technical term for instability, the tendency to change or break down.

clue.text: Extended courtesy for killer at Agincourt

parts.note: a bow is a courteous gesture

explanation.surface: A lengthy act of politeness is offered to a famous medieval slayer.
explanation.walkthrough: Agincourt (1415) was the English victory won largely by archers.
explanation.definitionFit: English archers' great bows killed thousands of French knights in that battle.

clue.text: His poetry attributed to Hubbard?

parts.note: verse credited to the Scientology founder, whose first name is Ron, describes a famous Romantic poet's name split in two

explanation.surface: A question of whether the Scientology founder wrote certain verse.
explanation.walkthrough: L. Ron Hubbard founded Scientology; work by him is 'by Ron', run together as a famous poet's name.
explanation.definitionFit: Lord Byron's poems are the poetry meant, the poet whose name splits as 'by Ron'.

clue.text: Stage set up

indicators.note: in a down clue, up means the word is read from bottom to top

parts.note: to gel is to set firm

explanation.surface: A theatre stage has been erected.
explanation.definitionFit: A leg is one stage of a journey or race, a section of it.

clue.text: Novelist's revolutionary opening enthrals press

indicators.note: enthrals means the turned word holds the other inside it
revolutionary means turned round, so the word is read backwards

explanation.surface: A writer's radical first chapter grips the newspapers.
explanation.walkthrough: 'press' is a verb, not the newspapers. 'revolutionary' turns the opening round, giving TNEV, and 'enthrals' holds the verb inside. The 's is 'is', a link.
explanation.definitionFit: Ivan Turgenev was the Russian author of Fathers and Sons.

clue.text: Damaging fall in a Jersey ditch?

parts.note: Jersey is one of the Channel Islands, abbreviated CI

explanation.surface: A harmful tumble into a ditch on the island of Jersey.
explanation.definitionFit: Polluted precipitation that harms forests and buildings is a fall of destructive rain.

clue.text: Look about and pull back

indicators.note: back means the word is read in reverse

explanation.surface: Someone glances around and then retreats.
explanation.definitionFit: To regard is to look at or gaze upon something.

clue.text: Girl rejecting dance shows bachelor out

indicators.note: out means the letter is put out of the word
rejecting means turning back, so the word is read in reverse

explanation.surface: A girl turning down a dance shows a single man the door.
explanation.walkthrough: 'rejecting' turns BALLETS into STELLAB; 'out' drops the B.
explanation.definitionFit: Stella is a female given name, so it is one girl.

clue.text: Rail supporter is overwhelmed by jokes

indicators.note: overwhelmed by means the short word is swamped inside the other

explanation.surface: Someone who backs the railways is swamped by gags.
explanation.definitionFit: A banister is the post-and-handrail structure on a staircase, holding up the rail.

clue.text: One can fill lots of cells — start making a bed?

definitions.text: One can fill lots of cells
definitions.meaning: a computer worksheet arranged in a grid of many cells
to lay out a bed linen layer is the first step in making a bed

explanation.surface: A puzzle over something that fills prison cells and a bed being made.
explanation.walkthrough: 'cells' suggests a prison or biology, but they are the boxes of a computer grid.
explanation.definitionFit: Spreadsheet programs fill grids of cells; spreading a sheet begins making a bed.

clue.text: We barristers' works bearing fruit

indicators.note: works means the letters are worked into a new order

explanation.surface: Lawyers claim their output is finally paying off.
explanation.definitionFit: Strawberries are soft red summer fruits.

clue.text: Source of funds to stop a pair of lifts trapping people

indicators.note: trapping means the turned word encloses the other
in a down clue, lifts means the word is raised, read upwards

explanation.surface: Money is needed to halt a couple of elevators catching passengers.
explanation.walkthrough: 'lifts' is a verb here: the pair is raised, giving OWT, and 'trapping' holds the people inside it.
explanation.definitionFit: An endowment is a gift of capital whose income funds an institution.

clue.text: Stop work as pirate

definitions.meaning: to finish the working day, down tools
an unauthorised copy of a product, a fake

explanation.surface: A buccaneer is told to stop his labours.
explanation.definitionFit: Knock off means finish work, and a knock-off is a pirated imitation.

clue.text: With surprising delicacy, open book

indicators.note: surprising means the letters are arranged unexpectedly

explanation.surface: Someone opens a volume with unexpected gentleness.
explanation.definitionFit: An encyclopedia is a reference work, a book of general knowledge.

clue.text: Boat's propeller: one gets feet wet

definitions.meaning: someone who drives a canoe with a paddle

explanation.surface: A boat's screw is the thing that gets your feet soaked.
explanation.definitionFit: A paddler drives a canoe along, or wades barefoot in the shallows.

clue.text: Open taking this seed for a spell

definitions.meaning: the word joined to open makes the magic command from Ali Baba
a small oily seed used in cooking

explanation.surface: Planting a seed opens something for a while.
explanation.walkthrough: 'for a spell' reads as 'for a while' but means as a magic charm: the words Ali Baba used to open the robbers' cave.
explanation.definitionFit: Sesame is a seed, and 'open sesame' is the spell from the Arabian Nights.

clue.text: Weirdly unlucky defendant gets run in

indicators.note: in means the letter goes into the word

parts.note: the accused is the defendant in a trial
R is the cricket abbreviation for run

explanation.surface: An oddly ill-starred defendant is taken into custody.
explanation.definitionFit: Accursed means under a curse, so dogged by strange ill fortune.

clue.text: Firm one enters changed hands

indicators.note: enters means the numeral goes inside the word

parts.note: I is the Roman numeral for one

explanation.surface: A company where someone joins after it has been sold.
explanation.definitionFit: Solid means firm, steady and unyielding.

clue.text: Ring cleaner

definitions.meaning: a flat ring placed under a nut or bolt

explanation.surface: Call the cleaning person.
explanation.definitionFit: A washer is a flat metal disc, and also someone who washes.

clue.text: Human being virtuous? About time

indicators.note: about means the word goes round the letter

explanation.surface: Wondering whether a person is good, at long last.
explanation.definitionFit: A mortal is a person, a being subject to death.

clue.text: Almost level in match

indicators.note: almost means the final letter is lost

explanation.surface: Nearly all square in a game.
explanation.definitionFit: A tie is a cup match or fixture between two teams.

clue.text: Claire regularly takes foreign language, not the right subject

indicators.note: regularly means every other letter of the name is taken
not the right means the R for right is dropped

explanation.surface: A student called Claire takes up a language, but not the correct one.
explanation.walkthrough: 'regularly' picks LIE from Claire; GERMAN loses its R.
explanation.definitionFit: A liegeman was a vassal owing feudal service, a subject of his lord.

clue.text: Criminal proposal to compass death

indicators.note: to compass is to surround, so the word encircles the other

explanation.surface: A plot to bring about someone's death is criminal.
explanation.walkthrough: 'compass' here means encircle, but it also means plot, as in compassing the king's death.
explanation.definitionFit: An offender is a criminal, one who breaks the law.

clue.text: First element of telephone number provides lead

indicators.note: first element of means only the initial letter is used

parts.note: ether is a number, a thing that numbs, an anaesthetic

explanation.surface: The opening digit of a phone number is a clue to follow.
explanation.walkthrough: 'number' is read as numb-er, something that numbs: ether, an old anaesthetic.
explanation.definitionFit: A tether is a lead or rope tying an animal.
